name: 組織メンバーの役割変更ダイアログ
prompt:
Recreate only the complete GitHub organization role-change dialog shown in the primary original crop. Match its 600:420 aspect ratio (about 1.43:1), white rounded modal, subtle shadow, pale-gray header, horizontal dividers, padding and compact GitHub-like typography. Do not include any dimmed page, member table or context behind the dialog. No Japanese mock exists for this source.

Header: title 「asmobbin のロールを変更しますか？」 in compact semibold dark text at the upper left, with a small close X at the upper right. Separate the header from the body with a thin light-gray line.

Body: heading 「新しいロールを選択」. Then show exactly two vertically stacked radio options, both unselected with empty circular controls. First, bold label 「オーナー」 and smaller gray description 「組織全体に対する完全な管理者アクセス権があります。」 Second, bold label 「メンバー」 and a two-line gray description 「組織内のすべてのメンバーと、シークレットではないチームを表示でき、新しいリポジトリを作成できます。」 Match the source option spacing, line breaks and left alignment.

Separate the footer with a thin horizontal divider. At the lower left, show the disabled 「ロールを変更」 button: pale neutral fill, faint gray outline and muted light-coral text. Keep it visibly disabled.

Preserve the username exactly as “asmobbin”, both empty radio states, the hierarchy and button state. Use restrained dark text, muted gray supporting copy, no extra actions or content.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 visually compared side-by-side with the complete original modal crop. Dimensions 1499x1049 (1.4280:1) against source 600x420 (1.4286:1); SHA-256 e9463fb50622fb74ceed8f1200f38d1ea64c103704daaf6e61b4a3d2751d8a6c. Modal bounds, title/close action, option hierarchy, both unselected radio controls, Japanese descriptions and disabled footer action closely match. Status: reviewed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
